source: In 2070, Los Angeles’s temperature will increase 3 degrees celsius.
claim: Los Angeles's temperature rises from 15.44 in 2023 to 18.43 in 2070, an increase of 2.99 degrees Celsius.

source: The city moves from a Temperate to Arid classification
claim: Los Angeles's classification changes from 'Temperate, dry summer, hot summer' in 2023 to 'Arid, steppe, hot' in 2070.

source: its climate will resemble how New Delhi feels today.
claim: New Delhi is the only city whose present-day classification, 'Arid, steppe, hot', matches the classification Los Angeles moves into by 2070.

source: Much of Scandinavia and Northern Europe change from Cold to Temperate climates.
claim: Among cities in the Cold zone in 2023, 12 are in the Temperate zone in 2070, 3 are in the Arid zone and 1 remains Cold.

source: The now Temperate cities, with hot or wet summers, become swallowed by the Tropical and Arid classifications.
claim: Among cities in the Temperate zone in 2023, 9 move to the Arid zone, 6 to the Tropical zone and 20 remain Temperate in 2070.

source: Moscow will be a lonely place in 2070, as the only remaining of our cities to exist in the Cold classification.
claim: In 2070 Moscow is the only city still in the Cold classification, in the 'Cold, no dry season, hot summer' class.

source: Temperate climates shifting north Tropical and Arid climates growing Cold climates disappearing.
claim: The Arid zone grows from 9 cities in 2023 to 22 in 2070 and the Tropical zone from 10 to 15, while the Cold zone shrinks from 16 to 1 and the Temperate zone from 35 to 32.
